parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for the query. This parameter supports a fuzzy search by disaster recovery plan name.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values are `en` for English and `zh` for Chinese. The default value is `zh`.

en: English.

en: English

Default value: zh.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.
